newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Esprit Telecom starts trade on Easdaq.
newsitem.headline: Esprit Telecom starts trade on Easdaq.

text.p: U.K.-based European telecommunications company, Esprit Telecom Group Plc, begins trading on the European small cap market Easdaq on Friday, an exchange statement released late on Thursday said.

The admission follows a joint initial public offering by the company on both Easdaq and the U.S. Nasdaq market, which raised $57 million for expanding the company's digital phone lines business. Nasdaq trade began Thursday.
Initial market makers on Easdaq will be Beeson Gregory, ING Bank, KB Securities, MeesPierson and Puilaetco, Easdaq said.
